verdict.rationale: Puzzle's AI Close is documented as using AI agents to automate the month-end process: reconciling accounts, reviewing transactions and surfacing discrepancies. That covers matching and exception-flagging. Separately, the startup page says busywork like matching invoices to payments is done automatically and reviewed by the user before anything is final, and the help center has a dedicated bank and credit-card reconciliation guide. The evidence is only short marketing and doc snippets, so the end-to-end depth is mostly implied. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how the agent matches transactions and handles exceptions, an explicit close-review and sign-off workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end close.
